newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MacroAsia says to sell 700 mln shrs to PAL.
newsitem.headline: MacroAsia says to sell 700 mln shrs to PAL.

text.p: MacroAsia Corp said on Tuesday its board had authorised the issuance of 700 million new shares in favour of Philippine Airlines (PAL).
The shares have an aggregate worth of 700 million pesos. MacroAsia, a recently converted holding company, offers inflight catering services at Manila airport.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, corporate secretary Gemma Santos said the shares, to be sourced from its unissued shares, would be issued to PAL under terms and conditions to be negotiated by its chairman Wee Ah Kee and PAL owners.
MacroAsia officials were not immediately available to comment on how large a stake the 700 million shares represented.
PAL's chief financial officer Jaime Bautista was also not immediately available to comment on MacroAsia's statement and public relations officials at PAL said they were not aware of a buy-in.
